format: Apertura: won by the first in the table.
Clausura: won by the first in the table.
The Apertura and Clausura winners (when in the Acumulada top 8) and the Acumulada's top two play two-legged semi-finals and a final; a club that wins both stages is champion.
The Tabla Acumulada adds up the stages' round robins; it decides the continental places after the champions.
The bottom 2 of the Tabla Acumulada go down.
